integrationWarnings.title: Level reward ticket IDs are SKUs/aliases, not canonical inventory ticket IDs
integrationWarnings.detail: Level options use reroll_1, bonus_exp_2, quest_skip, double_exp, mystery_unlock, rest_card, reroll_3 while tickets[] defines reroll, skip, boss_retry, bonus2, double, rest. Stage 6 must normalize these before inventory persistence; do not create seven accidental new ticket types.

integrationWarnings.title: Boss victory currently implies both 5 fragments and an explicit chapter chest if both rules are applied
integrationWarnings.detail: fragmentSources.bossWin=5 is enough for one normal chest, while every B01-B06 reward explicitly grants chest="chapter". RewardService needs an explicit policy on whether both are intended; do not silently double-award or discard one path.

integrationWarnings.title: Boss rewards reference badge display names, while badge catalog uses stable IDs and story-completion conditions
integrationWarnings.detail: BOSSES_6.json stores badge labels such as 金錢森林, but REWARD_SYSTEM uses IDs badge_story_ch1...badge_story_ch6 with conditions based on completing stories 1-5, 6-10, etc. Stage 6/7 should resolve by stable ID and define whether badge issuance occurs on story chapter completion, Boss defeat, or both idempotently.

integrationWarnings.title: Chest pool item entries are localized labels/categories rather than persistent item IDs
integrationWarnings.detail: Treat chest pool strings as design outcomes/categories to resolve through RewardService, not as durable inventory primary keys. Persist stable generated reward/asset IDs instead of localized display text.

integrationWarnings.title: Material reward filtering must preserve a valid Lv10 choice set
integrationWarnings.detail: When materialRewardPolicy.defaultEnabled=false, hide/disable only the small_gift option. Lv10 still has cosmetic and privilege choices, so choose=1 remains satisfiable. This is expected behavior, not a data error.
